description: Specify thermal wall or facet group names. Use of the group logic is described in Groups. By default, s is assigned to the group slot Default. Use the add keyword to assign the group name to the next available slot, and the remove keyword to remove s from all slots. The optional facet keyword can be given before the optional range to specify that the group name will be applied to thermal wall facets. In this case, the range is applied to thermal wall facets and not to thermal walls.

keywords.name: add
keywords.description: Assign s to the next available slot.

keywords.name: slot
keywords.description: Set group slot slot to s. By default, slot Default is used.

keywords.name: facet
keywords.description: Apply the group name to thermal wall facets; the range then applies to the facets and not to thermal walls.

examples.description: Assign the group in the Default slot

examples.command: wall thermal group 'wgf' facet range id 10
examples.description: Assign the group on the facets of wall 10

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): wall.thermal.isgroup reads True after assignment at wall and facet level on all six consoles.
